column1: 22097§scent§sent§Doctors mix light, sounds, breezes and scents to stimulate the patients.§医生同时采用光、声音、微风和**香味**来刺激病人。§
22098§hitherto§ˌhɪðəˈtuː§Hitherto, virtually all photographers developed and printed their own pictures.§事实上，**到目前为止**，所有的摄影师都亲自冲印自己拍摄的照片。§
22099§accomplish§əˈkʌmplɪʃ§We must accomplish the task before noon.§我们必须在中午之前**完成**这项任务。§
22100§bullet§ˈbʊlɪt§In reaction to the forward discharge of bullets, the gun moves backward.§发射**子弹**所产生的后坐力会使枪向后动一下。§
22101§rural§ˈrʊərəl§Technological advance will bring about the decline of rural industries and an increase in urban populations at the same time.§科技进步将会导致**农村**产业的衰退，同时会带来城市人口的增长。§

22102§enclosure§ɪnˈkləʊʒə(r)§Overseas trade, colonial plunder and the enclosure movement had accumulated abundant capital for greedy capitalists in Western countries.§海外贸易、殖民掠夺和**圈地**运动为西方贪婪的资本家积累了雄厚的资本。§

22103§discontinue§ˌdɪskənˈtɪnjuː§Without first consulting their health care provider, patients shall not discontinue the use of these medications.§在没有咨询过医护人员之前，患者不应该**中断**使用这些药物。§改例句：these 后应接复数，medication 改为 medications
22104§revegetate§riːˈvedʒɪˌteɪt§To revegetate is to replant and rebuild the soil of disturbed land.§**再植**是指重新种植植物，复原被破坏的土壤。§
22105§sustainable§səˈsteɪnəbl§As a win-win technology between human and nature, green science and technology is the essential way to sustainable development.§作为一种能使人与自然双赢的科学技术，绿色科技是通向**可持续**发展的必由之路。§
22106§dispersal§dɪˈspɜːsl§After receiving the fire alarm, the firefighters rushed to the scene and quickly finished the dispersal of the crowd that had gathered.§接到火警后，消防人员迅速赶到现场，紧急**疏散**聚集的人群。§
22107§fabulous§ˈfæbjələs§There is a fabulous performance this weekend in accordance with the poster.§海报上说，这周末有一场**很棒**的演出。§
22108§retailing§ˈriːteɪlɪŋ§With the developing and popularizing of retailing, brand has changed into a symbol of products reputation for these manufacturers.§随着**零售业**的发展和普及，品牌变成制造商产品声誉的象征。§
22109§rental§ˈrentl§Having one of these following cases, lessor shall terminate the rental agreement in advance.§如有下列情形之一，出租人可以提前终止房屋**租赁**合同。§改例句：可数名词单数 rental agreement 前缺冠词，补 the
22110§fraught§frɔːt§The earliest operations employing this technique were fraught with dangers.§最早采用这一技术的手术**充满**了危险。§
22111§obsession§əbˈseʃn§It is said that General Charles De Gaulle had an obsession with Mona Lisa which is one of the masterpieces of the Renaissance.§据说戴高乐将军对《蒙娜丽莎》这幅文艺复兴时期的名作非常**着迷**。§
22112§ethereal§ɪˈθɪəriəl§Entering the resort and breathing the clear and ethereal air, you will find yourself strolling in a haven of peace.§进入度假胜地，呼吸着清新**缥缈**的空气，你就发现自己仿佛进入了世外桃源。§
22113§unobtrusive§ˌʌnəbˈtruːsɪv§Listening to some quiet and unobtrusive music is one of the ways for me to find the inner tranquility after a long day.§漫长的一天过后，听一些轻柔**平和**的音乐是我寻求内心平静的方式之一。§

22114§underpin§ˌʌndəˈpɪn§The Copenhagen Conference appeals to all developed countries to reduce emissions by at least 80% in the same period and underpin these efforts through robust and comparable mid-term reductions.§哥本哈根会议呼吁所有发达国家在同一时期内至少减排80%，同时通过中期有力的类似减排措施来**巩固**这一成绩。§
22115§nutritional§njuˈtrɪʃənl§This book provides nutritional information on over 3,000 different foods.§这本书介绍了有关三千多种食物的**营养**知识。§改例句：different 修饰多种食物，food 应为复数 foods

22116§velocity§vəˈlɒsəti§The parameters involved in this essay include mass ratio, initial relative impact velocity, absolute mass and relative acceleration.§这篇论文涉及的参数有：质量比、初始相对碰撞**速度**、绝对质量和相对加速度。§改例句：主语 The parameters 是复数，includes 应为 include

22117§unveil§ˌʌnˈveɪl§The municipality decided to unveil its 2020 budget plan finally after several rounds of seminars with lawmakers and economic experts.§经过与立法者和经济学家数回合的研究讨论，市政当局终于决定**公布**2020年的预算方案。§
22118§prototype§ˈprəʊtətaɪp§Though still in prototype phase, the gloves seem to have impressed the experts.§尽管仍处于**原型**阶段，这种手套似乎给专家们留下了深刻的印象。§
22119§swivel§ˈswɪvl§The old man sat down on a squeaky swivel chair and dozed fitfully.§老人坐在嘎吱作响的**转**椅里，断断续续地打着瞌睡。§

22120§replicate§ˈreplɪkeɪt§A new computer virus was reportedly found in the new operating system by replicating itself and passing along from user to user.§据报道，在新的操作系统中发现了一种新型电脑病毒，它通过自我**复制**在电脑用户间传播。§改例句：主语 virus 是单数，themselves 应为 itself
22121§capsize§kæpˈsaɪz§Things are always contradictory and interdependent to each other, as water can carry the boat, but it can also capsize it.§事物总是相互对立又相互依存的，正如“水能载舟，亦能**覆**舟”。§
22122§project§ˈprɒdʒekt§I think this project could be adapted to suit any age.§我觉得可以将该**计划**加以改动以适合所有年龄的人群。§
22123§thorny§ˈθɔːni§This thorny problem on environmental protection floored the new mayor.§这个关于环境保护的**棘手**问题把新市长难住了。§
22124§eligible§ˈelɪdʒəbl§You are eligible for a student loan if you are a UK resident.§如果你是英国居民，就**可以申请**学生贷款。§
22125§admit§ədˈmɪt§Bill was forced to admit that he had cheated on the test.§比尔被迫**承认**他在考试中作弊了。§
22126§bacterial§bækˈtɪəriəl§Leaving any remaining nonviable tissue may create an environment for bacterial growth.§留下任何残存的死组织都可能为**细菌**生长创造环境。§
22127§management§ˈmænɪdʒmənt§Why do you think that some changes have come about in the national revenue management?§你为什么会认为国家税收**管理**发生了改变呢？§改例句：去掉问号前的空格
22128§enrolment§ɪnˈrəʊlmənt§When you apply for a student loan, most banks ask you to bring your passport and your letter or certificate of enrolment.§申请学生贷款的时候，很多银行会要求你随身携带护照、入学介绍信或**入学**证明。§
22129§strategy§ˈstrætədʒi§The Ottawa Charter presents fundamental strategies and approaches in achieving health for all.§《渥太华宪章》提出了实现全民健康的基本**策略**和方法。§
22130§emerge§ɪˈmɜːdʒ§A new style of architecture emerged to reflect more idealistic notions for the future.§一种新的建筑风格**出现**了，它反映了未来更为理想的建筑理念。§
22131§submerge§səbˈmɜːdʒ§The city was submerged by the flood.§这座城市被洪水**淹没**了。§
22132§mantle§ˈmæntl§Magma surged into the volcano from the Earth's mantle.§岩浆从地球的**地幔**涌入火山。§
22133§overall§ˌəʊvərˈɔːl§The overall absence rate of the company is 3.6 percent in the first year.§公司第一年度的**总**缺勤率为3.6%。§
22134§granite§ˈgrænɪt§This provided 7,000 cubic metres of granite to add to the island's foundations.§这为小岛地基的建设提供了7,000立方米的**花岗石**。§
22135§approximate§əˈprɒksɪmət§I would like to know the approximate price of this car.§我想了解一下这辆车的**大概**价位。§
22136§gallery§ˈgæləri§We'll go to the Picture Gallery with a marvellous collection of paintings all by Australian artists.§我们将前往**美术馆**，那里收藏了一些优秀的画作，它们全部出自澳大利亚画家之手。§

22137§community§kəˈmjuːnəti§Detailed surveys of social and economic trends in the European Community show that Europe's population is falling and getting older.§欧洲**共同体**开展的关于社会经济趋势的详细调查显示，欧洲人口在减少且开始呈现老龄化趋势。§改译文：「欧共体」是缩写，括不出 Community，改为全称「欧洲共同体」
22138§swing§swɪŋ§The bus swung sharply to the left.§公共汽车猛地**拐**向左边。§

22139§cite§saɪt§Studies of the sources cited in publications lead to a conclusion: the use of foreign-language sources is often found to be as low as 10 percent.§对于出版物中**引用**的原始资料的研究得出了一个结论：外语资料的使用通常仅占10％。§
22140§spectrum§ˈspektrəm§Sufferers can fight back by spending a few hours each day under special, full-spectrum lamps.§患者可以通过每天在特制的全**光谱**灯下照射几小时来缓解身体的不适。§
22141§drawback§ˈdrɔːbæk§The only drawback to the plan is the expense.§该计划的唯一**缺点**是费用问题。§
22142§identity§aɪˈdentəti§If people want to enter this building, their identities must be authenticated by an electronic scanner.§如果人们想进入这座大楼，需经电子扫描仪进行**身份**验证。§
22143§trend§trend§In your opinion, will this trend continue into the future?§依你看，这种**趋势**在未来还会继续吗？§
22144§extreme§ɪkˈstriːm§One mistake we often make when stricken with extreme back pain is to go to bed and stay there.§当背部出现**剧**痛时我们经常犯的一个错误就是上床躺着。§
22145§skip§skɪp§She skips the difficult words when she reads English novels.§看英文小说时她经常**跳过**难词。§
22146§military§ˈmɪlətri§The gizmo is called the Army Flashlight because it was developed initially for military use.§这种小发明被称为“军队闪光灯”，因为它最初是为**军事**目的研制的。§
22147§vested§ˈvestɪd§The politicians didn't have the courage to confront the vested interest that subsidies create.§政治家们没有勇气去对抗补贴带来的**既得**利益。§
22148§symphony§ˈsɪmfəni§The audience were all enchanted by the engrossing symphony.§**交响乐**美妙绝伦，听众全都陶醉其中。§
22149§locate§ləʊˈkeɪt§The college is located at London Road.§这所大学**位于**伦敦路。§改译文：句末漏了句号
22150§classify§ˈklæsɪfaɪ§The researcher has classified environmental tobacco smoke in the highest risk category for causing cancer.§研究人员将环境香烟烟雾**归类**于最高风险致癌物。§

22151§enthusiastic§ɪnˌθjuːziˈæstɪk§With lights flashing and horns honking, the newly-manufactured vehicles poured into the world like enthusiastic machines from the science-fiction movie.§车灯闪烁，喇叭轰鸣，新生产出来的汽车就像是科幻电影中**充满热情**的机器一样涌入大千世界。§改译文：删去句末排版残留「的）」；「充满动力」不是 enthusiastic（热情的）的意思，改为「充满热情」
22152§alter§ˈɔːltə(r)§We may be able to alter our genetic inheritance if we so choose.§如果愿意，我们可以**改变**自己的基因遗传。§
22153§disqualify§dɪsˈkwɒlɪfaɪ§Will this disqualify me from getting a student loan?§这会不会**取消**我获得学生贷款的资格？§改译文：原译「让我失去…资格」括不出 disqualify（取消资格），改译
22154§maximum§ˈmæksɪməm§Students on a visitor visa or work permit may study for a maximum of 3 months.§持旅行签证或工作许可证的学生**最多**可有三个月的学习时间。§

22155§delivery§dɪˈlɪvəri§The invention of the motor vehicle brought personal mobility to the masses and made rapid freight delivery possible over a much wider area.§机动车的发明带来了人员的大规模流动，同时使得更大区域内的快速货**运**成为可能。§

22156§undergraduate§ˌʌndəˈɡrædʒuət§The Universities of Oxford and Cambridge recently held joint conferences to discuss the noticeably rapid decline in literacy among undergraduates.§牛津大学和剑桥大学近期召开了几次联合会议，讨论**本科生**文化水平显著快速下降的问题。§
22157§focus§ˈfəʊkəs§The primary focus of attention in the twentieth century has been on small-scale societies.§在20世纪，小型社会成了人们首要关注的**焦点**。§
22158§administer§ədˈmɪnɪstə(r)§The personnel director administers the attendance policy.§人事经理**负责**考勤。§
22159§ash§æʃ§The volcanic ash caused a lot of damage in the village.§火山**灰**给村庄造成了很大的破坏。§
22160§intensify§ɪnˈtensɪfaɪ§The strong wind seemed to intensify the cold.§狂风似乎**加剧**了寒冷。§改译文：原译「使天气更加寒冷」括不出 intensify（加剧），改译
22161§inventory§ˈɪnvəntri§Managing agents can offer a total service from reliable sourcing, managing inventory to budget control and distribution.§运营代理商可以提供从可靠货源、库房**存货**管理到预算控制和商品分销的全套服务。§
22162§event§ɪˈvent§Your graduation from college is an important event.§你大学毕业了，这是件**大事**。§
22163§crucial§ˈkruːʃl§The presence of human beings is crucial to the survival of the forest.§人类的存在对森林的存活**至关重要**。§
22164§stage§steɪdʒ§The next stage of the project is the design phase.§该项目的下一个**阶段**是设计阶段。§
22165§aeration§eəˈreɪʃn§The tunnels abandoned by the beetles provide excellent aeration and water channels for root systems of plants.§被甲虫遗弃的地下通道为植物的根系提供了绝佳的**通风**和汲水管道。§
22166§profitable§ˈprɒfɪtəbl§It is profitable for employers to work their existing employees hard.§雇主让他们的雇员努力工作是**有利可图**的。§
22167§faith§feɪθ§People have to have faith in their ability to carry out the task their boss has set them.§大家必须**相信**自己有能力完成老板布置的任务。§
22168§cafeteria§ˌkæfəˈtɪəriə§Bill had lunch in the school cafeteria.§比尔在学校**食堂**吃的午饭。§
